description: Encode the Decision-Log 'when to use it' rules. Set whichever apply: `escalation_fired`, `gate_resolved_cross_cutting`, `affects_multiple_tickets`, `override_architectural`, `confined_to_one_session`. Returns { should_log, reason, entry_template? }; when should_log is true the Context/Trigger/Decision/Rationale/Affects skeleton is returned. A decision confined to one session does not need an entry — the session notes suffice.
name: decision_log_guidance
title: Judge whether a situation belongs in the Decision Log
